export const PILLARS = [
  { num: "١", icon: "☝️", name: "Shahada", arabic: "الشهادة", desc: "Declaration that there is no god but Allah and Muhammad ﷺ is His final messenger — the gateway into Islam." },
  { num: "٢", icon: "🕌", name: "Salah",   arabic: "الصلاة",  desc: "Five daily prayers at their prescribed times: Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, and Isha." },
  { num: "٣", icon: "💚", name: "Zakat",   arabic: "الزكاة",  desc: "Obligatory annual charity (2.5% of savings) given to those in need, purifying one's wealth." },
  { num: "٤", icon: "🌙", name: "Sawm",    arabic: "الصوم",   desc: "Fasting the month of Ramadan from dawn to sunset — discipline, gratitude, and closeness to Allah." },
  { num: "٥", icon: "🕋", name: "Hajj",    arabic: "الحج",    desc: "Pilgrimage to Mecca once in a lifetime for those physically and financially able." },
];
